issues.title: RTL punctuation displacement
issues.description: English helper text inherits RTL directionality causing periods to render at the beginning of wrapped lines.
issues.evidence: Switch descriptions show periods at the start of '.manual review', '.Clients...', and '.session'.
issues.suggestion: Set dir='auto' or explicit LTR isolation on English text elements.
issues.triageNote:
Switch renders no text; the English descriptions are plain

nodes composed by the eval page itself (src/app/eval/pair-028/page.tsx RuleRow) inside a dir=rtl shell, so bidi moves trailing periods. Root cause is page composition in a file fix agents may not edit — not a ui:switch defect.

issues.title: Switch active thumb rendering defect
issues.description: The switch thumb in active state displays an uneven crescent cutout artifact.
issues.evidence: Active switches for Auto-confirm and Reminder emails show irregular thumb clipping on the track.
issues.suggestion: Adjust thumb inset and track overflow styling for consistent thumb geometry.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: checked-state thumb used physical translate-x-[calc(100%-2px)] which in RTL pushed the 16px thumb 13px outside the 32px track (eval-agent DOM measurement: thumb x 70-86 vs track right edge 73). Fixed with rtl:-translate-x mirror in src/components/ui/switch.tsx.
